title: Rewrite create_block_screen.dart to new design system
instructions:
Rewrite lib/ui/carnivalBlock/createBlock/widgets/create_block_screen.dart using the new design system primitives. Pattern: FORM (single input or few).

**Cubit (DO NOT MODIFY):** reads existing CreateBlockCubit from ../cubit/ - already wired in lib/routing/router.dart. Constructor signature MUST stay identical.

**Widgets to use:** AppAppBar(title: 'Criar bloco'), AppCard (wrapping the form), AppTextField (for name field with label/hint/errorText), AppButton(label: 'Criar', variant: .primary, isFullWidth: true), AppSnackbar.

**Layout guidance:**
1. AppAppBar with title 'Criar bloco', showBackButton: true (default).
2. Body: SingleChildScrollView containing an AppCard with the form inside.
3. Form: BlocConsumer<CreateBlockCubit, CreateBlockState> listening for status changes.
   - On success: AppSnackbar.success(context: context, message: 'Bloco criado com sucesso'), then context.pop().
   - On failure: AppSnackbar.error with the user-friendly message (use error-to-user-message patterns).
   - On submit: call cubit.createBlock(name: controller.text) with the form field value.
4. AppTextField for the block name (label: 'Nome do bloco', hint: 'Ex.: Bloco da Saudade', TextInputAction.done, autofocus: true).
5. AppButton at bottom - isLoading when state.status == loading; isDisabled when name is empty.

**Preserve exactly:** constructor signature, cubit API, all pt-BR strings (do NOT translate existing user-facing text).
validation: All string literals use double quotes
Cubit API (createBlock method) call signature unchanged
Screen widget class name `CreateBlockScreen` and constructor `const CreateBlockScreen({super.key})` preserved
NO emojis as icons - Material Symbols Rounded only
On submit success: AppSnackbar.success then context.pop()
On submit failure: AppSnackbar.error with user-friendly pt-BR message
